Entertainment

Glimpse has a long record in entertainment marketing, working with cinema chains, film distributors and studios across the region. We know how to build anticipation before a release and keep audiences engaged after it.

For venues, platforms and promoters in Qatar, we plan release and event campaigns, run social communities in Arabic and English, produce trailers, cut-downs and creator content, and use paid media to fill seats and drive subscriptions.

Every campaign is tied to a number that matters to you: tickets sold, footfall, sign-ups or viewing time.
